description: Import landed cost calculator — Full landed cost of an import shipment. Give value (goods invoice value in USD, excluding international freight and insurance) and optionally freight, insurance, dutyRate (percent, from /v1/trade/hts-lookup), extraRate (Section 301/232 or other additional tariff percent), brokerage, inland, other, mode (ocean, air, truck, rail), country (US default; CIF-basis countries like GB/DE get duty on CIF), vatRate, qty and price (unit sell price). For US entries adds the Merchandise Processing Fee (0.3464%, FY2027 min $34.58 max $670.86; informal entry $2.77) and Harbor Maintenance Fee (0.125%, ocean). Returns customs value, line-item breakdown with shares, duties and fees, landed cost, multiplier, unit landed cost and unit margin with a verdict. Offline, instant. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: logistics_landed_cost
